text:
maya: Heads up — starting onboarding for robertaX-13b. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/robertaX/13b/v1/weights.tar. Need a quick smoke before I open the model-config PR.

sam: Quick Q — when you exported the tokenizer did you use HF's PreTrainedTokenizerFast? My local run shows vocab_size 50265 vs expected 50257 and special tokens seem shifted.

ben: ran the validator, failing on kv-cache/kernel selection. Snippet:
```
[2026-02-24T09:12:03Z] ERROR: kernel_not_found: no compatible attention kernel for arch sm_80 with current Triton binary, falling back to slower kernel
[2026-02-24T09:12:03Z] WARN: falling back to CPU attention, huge perf hit
```

sam: that looks like a CUDA/Triton mismatch. Which base image did the container use? Triton kernels for the new fused-attn need CUDA 12+ (and Triton build with 12.*).

maya: our Dockerfile used nvidia/cuda:11.8-cudnn8 as the base (legacy). I was assuming Triton would handle it but seems not. I can rebuild on cuda:12.1 and bump tritonserver to 2.15.0.

lee: +1. For fused-attn and the new kernel selectors we definitely need CUDA 12.1 and NCCL 2.17 in the image. Also confirm the compiler flags in the build (sm_80 enabled).

oliver: CI ping — can we run the existing smoke tests before/after rebuild so we have a baseline?

ci-bot: CI triggered: model-smoke/robertaX-13b #2678 — running the current image smoke tests. Logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2678 (initial run uses existing image)

ben: CI failed on the same kernel lookup. Suggest we add a clearer validator failure for kernel mismatch so devs don't waste cycles. Maybe "validate --check-kernel" flag that fails early.

sam: agreed. Also tokenizer: looks like an export used legacy tokenizers v1. Quick fix in model-config: add "tokenizer_type": "byte-level-bpe" and set "vocab_size": "50265" if that's what the files contain. But better to re-export to canonical HF format.

maya: I'm going to: 1) rebuild container on cuda:12.1 + tritonserver:2.15.0, 2) re-export tokenizer with PreTrainedTokenizerFast, 3) update model-config + PR. I'll trigger CI after rebuild.

ci-bot: Build #2679 started (rebuild on cuda:12.1). Dockerfile change: FROM nvidia/cuda:12.1-cudnn8-devel-ubuntu22.04; Triton:2.15.0.

maya: Re-exported tokenizer and pushed model-config change in PR #379. Short config snippet added to the PR:
```json
{"model_name": "robertaX-13b", "tokenizer_type": "byte-level-bpe", "vocab_size": "50265", "max_sequence": "2048"}
```

sam: reviewing PR #379 now :eyes: main thing I want to check is that we didn't accidentally change bos/eos ids. If that's ok, will approve.

lee: reserving 2 GPUs on the dedicated pool for canary once CI passes. I'll run perf baseline (p95 latency, throughput at batch sizes 1/4/8).

oliver: also add a rollout config with an automatic rollback on >5% error rate or OOM. Example: "rollback_policy": "auto:on_error,oom"

ben: I added a small tokenizer roundtrip check to model-tools: `python -m model_tools.validate --model-path s3://redwood-models/robertaX/13b/v1 --tokenizer-check roundtrip` — will fail if decode(encode(text)) != text for sample prompts. Add that to CI.

ci-bot: Build #2679 succeeded. Smoke tests passed. Model validator passed tokenization and kernel checks. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2679/artifacts

maya: deploying canary to dedicated pool now. Plan: 2x A100 (reserved by @lee), 100 concurrent warmup queries, then perf run. If p95 < 120ms and no OOM, promote.

sam: left a small comment on PR about updating the model README with the tokenizer export steps.

lee: perf run done — p95 98ms batch1, throughput 420 tokens/s batch8, no OOM. Looks good.

oliver: I'll add the rollback policy and promote to prod after a short watch window. Thanks all. :tada:

maya: thanks everyone. I'll merge PR and follow up with a post in #eng-releases once it's live.

ben: can we add a short checklist for next onboards: weights path verification, tokenizer export cmd, base image CUDA/Triton matrix, kernel sanity check command, and a canary run template. Saves a lot of back-and-forth.

maya: yep, will add to the onboarding checklist doc after this.

ci-bot: Note: artifacts and logs stored at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/2679/ (contains docker image digest, validator logs, smoke results).
